m: यित्थ m. N. of a man, Rājat.
यियासा f. (fr. Desid.) desire of going, HPariś.
यिया˚सु mfn. wishing to go or move or ride or drive or fly &c.
intending to set off or depart, desirous of marching or taking the field (with dat. or acc. with or without प्रति), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
यियक्षत् (R.), यिय˚क्षमाण and यिय˚क्षु (MBh.), mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to worship or sacrifice.
यियप्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) desiring sexual intercourse, Sāy. on RV. x, 86, 17.
यियप्स्यमाना f. desiring to be carnally known, ŚāṅkhŚr.
यियविषा f. (fr. Desid.) the wish to mix or blend, W.
यियवि˚षु mfn. wishing to mix or fill or cover with (instr.), Bhaṭṭ.
